statements.markdown: **Lemma 6.53 (Changing finitely many support elements).** *Let $b\ge2$ be an integer, and let $A,B\subseteq\mathbb N_{\ge1}$. If $X_A(b)$ is irrational and $A,B$ have finite symmetric difference, then $X_B(b)$ is irrational too: the two sums differ by a finite sum of rational numbers. This observation supplies the finite modifications in Theorem [6.21](#thm:eventually-periodic).*
